target.title: Guard repository size and document history cleanup
target.body:
## Summary

- remove the duplicate root `codexbar.png` and point the README at the byte-identical copy under `docs/`
- reject tracked files over 2 MiB and common generated app/release artifacts during `make check`
- cover the guard with an isolated temporary-repository regression test
- document measured clone-size causes, smaller-clone options, and a maintainer-only history cleanup runbook

## Root cause

The changelog is not responsible for the 100+ MB clone:

| Measurement at `61ff9320` | Size |
| --- | ---: |
| Packed Git object database | 103.91 MiB |
| Current tracked tree | 22,292,801 bytes |
| Current `CHANGELOG.md` | 150,271 bytes |
| All historical changelog blobs, compressed | about 0.55 MB |

The dominant compressed history groups are removed `screenshots/` blobs (39,023,716 bytes), the retired `Quotio/`
tree (23,141,837 bytes), accidentally committed `CodexBar 2.app/` contents (7,088,125 bytes), and
`CodexBar-0.2.2.zip` (2,296,323 bytes). The largest individual blob is the retired 49,202,546-byte
`Quotio/Resources/Proxy/cli-proxy-api-plus` executable.

Deleting those paths in later commits stopped new growth but cannot remove already reachable objects from a normal
PR.

## Proof

- `codexbar.png` and `docs/codexbar.png` had the same SHA-1 (`ef0151453457ab81309d6f6ec2d7de5c2f789007`); the
  README renders the retained path and a full checkout drops 306,204 duplicate bytes.
- The new regression test proves untracked large build output is ignored, then proves the same file is rejected once
  tracked; it separately proves a small tracked release ZIP is rejected by path.
- An isolated mirror rehearsal filtered only the documented retired paths, repacked from 103.90 MiB to 41.99 MiB
  (59.6%), and passed `git fsck --full --no-dangling`.
- The rehearsal was intentionally isolated. This PR does **not** rewrite canonical history or force-push refs.

## Validation

- `./Scripts/check_repository_size.sh` — passes (1,561 tracked files, 2 MiB maximum)
- `./Scripts/test_repository_size.sh` — passes
- `node Scripts/check-documentation-links.mjs` — 143 local links pass
- `make docs-list` — passes and includes the new front matter
- `make check` — passes; SwiftFormat and strict SwiftLint report zero violations
- `git diff --check` — passes
- isolated `git filter-repo` mirror rehearsal — 103.90 MiB before, 41.99 MiB after; full fsck passes
- `make test` — attempted, but SwiftPM stopped before test discovery because downloading Sparkle's public binary
  artifact invoked a macOS Keychain credential lookup (`status -128`). It was not retried or bypassed, per the
  repository's no-Keychain-prompt testing policy.

No app/runtime behavior changes. Screenshot proof and changelog entry are not applicable to this repository-tooling
and documentation cleanup.

## History rewrite boundary

The documented filter is a recommendation, not an action performed by this branch. A canonical rewrite changes
commit/tag IDs and requires a maintenance window, force-push coordination, and contributor re-clones or careful
rebases; that decision remains with maintainers.
